name: Temporary user budget for a contractor (invalid → fixed, stale approval, beneficiary confirms)
description: A user-scope budget with an expiry date. The first version is invalid (user budgets cannot have alert recipients). After the fix the requestor submits, a Copilot admin approves, then the requestor edits the amount: the approval is voided by the content digest and the request must be resubmitted and re-approved. The named user confirms as the budget beneficiary.

budget_enforcement: Stop usage when the budget is reached
values.budget_justification: Contractor migrating the settlement batch jobs to Java 21 through December; needs agent mode beyond the default per-user allowance.

selected: I understand spend up to this amount is billed to CoolEngEnt and charged back to the cost center above
My manager is aware of this request

steps.note: The requestor removes the alert recipients; the summary comment is updated in place.
Editing the body after submission changes the digest: recorded approvals no longer apply.
